description: This file defines the MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter class, which implements the io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap interface. Its purpose is to extract message properties from AMQP 1.0 message annotations based on a specified annotation name. It provides methods to iterate over extracted message properties and throws an exception if an attempt is made to set properties.

classes.name: MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for extracting properties from an AMQP 1.0 message's message annotations, implementing the TextMap interface for tracing propagation.

methods.name: MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a message and the name of the message annotation map containing properties. Throws NullPointerException if arguments are null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the message properties stored in the annotations. Converts the annotation entries into String key-value pairs.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Unsupported operation; method throws UnsupportedOperationException if called.

methods.name: getPropertiesMap
methods.description: Retrieves the map of properties from the message annotations based on the specified annotation name. Returns an empty map if annotations are missing or not of the expected type.
